item.title: 'We're not done yet': Montana State storms into national championship
item.description: "This team brings you so much joy as a coach because so many guys have stepped into new roles and taken it upon themselves to become the best version of themselves."

item.title: Montana laments 'atrocious start,' tough outcome in semifinal loss at Montana State
item.description: It was a tough end to a strong season for the Montana Grizzlies as they fell 48-23 to rival Montana State on Saturday in the first playoff matchup between the schools.

item.title: 'No quit': Montana, dealing with emotions of semifinal loss, goes back to drawing board
item.description: The Montana Grizzlies got on the doorstep of reaching the national championship game, but fell just short after their second loss of the season, both to Montana State.
